backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user profiles (Junior/Senior roles), doubt posting/retrieval, answer management with ratings, senior leaderboard, and authorization checks using mixins for storage and access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the login/authentication entry point modification is implemented across App.tsx, Layout.tsx, and LoginScreen.tsx with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of all frontend source files covering authentication flow, UI components, hooks, pages, and styling with warm educational color palette.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color palettes using OKLCH color space for consistent design system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the React application titled 'askin'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that shows LoginScreen for unauthenticated users or RouterProvider with routes (doubts, doubt detail, leaderboard) for authenticated users after checking identity initialization.
frontend/src/components/AnswerCard.tsx: Card component displaying answer details including responder profile, rating stars, text content, downloadable notes/video attachments, and interactive rating input for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AnswerForm.tsx: Form for Senior users to post answers with text explanation, optional notes/video file uploads with progress tracking, and submission handling using ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/AnswersList.tsx: List component fetching and displaying all answers for a specific doubt with loading skeletons, error handling, and empty state messaging.
frontend/src/components/DoubtCard.tsx: Displays a single doubt as a clickable card with author info, timestamp, description, and optional image attachment. Navigates to the doubt detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/DoubtForm.tsx: Form component for posting new doubts with a text description and optional image upload. Shows upload progress and handles image preview/removal.
frontend/src/components/DoubtsFeed.tsx: Fetches and displays all doubts in reverse chronological order using DoubtCard components. Shows loading skeletons, error alerts, or empty state as needed.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with header (logo, navigation, user profile, login button), main content area, and footer. Conditionally shows RoleSetupModal for authenticated users without profiles.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardTable: Displays a ranked table of users by points with special styling for top 3 positions. Each row shows rank icons, user avatar/name, and point badges.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Toggles between login and logout states using Internet Identity. Clears query cache on logout and handles authentication errors.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Landing page for unauthenticated users with branding, feature highlights (ask doubts, share knowledge, earn recognition), and a login button.
frontend/src/components/RatingInput.tsx: Allows users to rate an answer with stars (1-5). Shows success message after rating and prevents duplicate ratings.
frontend/src/components/RatingStars.tsx: A reusable star rating component that displays 1-5 stars, supports both readonly display and interactive rating selection with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/RoleSetupModal.t: A modal dialog for first-time user onboarding that collects the user's name and role (Junior or Senior) and saves their profile using the useSaveCallerUserProfile hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDoubts.ts: React Query hook that fetches all doubts from the backend actor, returning an array of Principal-Doubt tuples.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAnswersForDoubt: React Query hook that fetches all answers for a specific doubt ID, returning an array of Principal-Answer tuples.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile, with special handling for loading states and actor availability.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetLeaderboard.ts: React Query hook that fetches the leaderboard data showing user rankings from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserProfile.ts: React Query hook that fetches a specific user's profile by their Principal ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and providing login/logout functionality with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/usePostAnswer.ts: React Query mutation hook for posting an answer to a doubt with text, notes, and video attachments, invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePostDoubt.ts: React Query mutation hook for creating a new doubt with description and optional attachment, invalidating the doubts list on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useRateAnswer.ts: React Query mutation hook for rating an answer, invalidating both the answers list and leaderboard queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook for saving the current user's profile, invalidating the currentUserProfile query on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors using an orange/amber color scheme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/DoubtDetailPage.tsx: Page component displaying a single doubt with its details, answers list, and an answer form for senior users, with navigation back to the doubts list.
frontend/src/pages/DoubtsPage.tsx: Main page displaying a hero banner introducing the Askin platform, a feed of recent doubts, and a sidebar with either a doubt submission form (for juniors) or an informational message (for seniors).
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Leaderboard page showing top seniors ranked by points, with a header explaining the points system (+5 for answers, +1-5 bonus for ratings) and displaying the LeaderboardTable component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, custom animations, typography plugin, and design tokens for a warm educational UI.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing Askin as a student Q&A platform with junior/senior roles, Firebase backend, rating system, leaderboard, and implemented features including authentication, doubt posting, answering, and points system.
